verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook generates report types such as briefing documents, study guides, FAQs, and custom reports, and offers auto-generated summaries. Chat responses keep their tables when saved as notes, notes export to Google Docs or Sheets, and notebooks can be shared publicly by link (slide decks also as PDF). Together these cover producing and sharing a structured report with stakeholders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that generated reports themselves contain sections and tables, direct export or sharing of the generated report artifact itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of report quality.
